cohort.no_substitution: Retain empty/unclear/failed scenes and their status. Technical failure stops that scene, not replacement. If the chosen pool fails, issue a separate prospective protocol for a different source, disclose failure.
cohort.old_216: All old v2 candidates and split roles preserved; no new reserved payloads or scores.
cohort.role: Feasibility/development only, permanently excluded from future formal confirmation.
cohort.selection: Hash of public event and sample identity; fixed before image, mask, prediction or outcome access.

decision_after_pilot: Unusable provenance or instance truth: stop this data route.
Unusable detector on new events: solve/qualify measurement first, not search.
Detector usable but source utility transfers adequately: no evidence to justify a new transfer method from this pilot.
Detector usable and event-specific utility mismatch reproducible: formulate one constrained adaptation hypothesis, with observable information and charged costs, in a new protocol.

hypotheses.falsification: No usable per-instance gold or no detectable targets means the proposed search experiment is not supported by this pilot. It cannot be repaired by selecting more favorable scenes or increasing planner depth.
hypotheses.measurement: Externally selected scenes have human-reviewable individual buildings and nonzero fixed-detector discovery opportunities in each event. This may fail.
hypotheses.transfer: Frozen source utility ranking and upgrade prices may disagree with target-event realized marginal discoveries; assess descriptively before designing adaptation.

independence_and_future_confirmation.event_identity: External event names are outside the published xBD event list, but names/dates alone are insufficient for full acquisition or geographic independence.
independence_and_future_confirmation.future_requirement: If this feasibility stage supports the problem, select a separate external cohort by event/acquisition/footprint evidence before labels or outcomes. All18 pilot pairs remain development. No new method promotion before a distinct evaluation plan and verified nearest work.
independence_and_future_confirmation.spatial_status: UNKNOWN: no acquisition/official footprint mapping verified from this metadata-only stage.

name: disaster_search_v3_external_feasibility_18
research_scope: Cross-disaster transfer of budgeted optical image search with imperfect fixed detector feedback. No new algorithm or paper contribution is selected.

stage_a_now.allowed: Source papers, README and exact archive directories only

after_rgb_extraction: Check actual 512x512 RGB dimensions, pre/post alignment, missing pixels and image hashes; record failures without swapping.
Check acquisition IDs/dates and available footprints plus exact/perceptual duplicates against known training/evaluation imagery. Report unavailable spatial evidence as unknown, never independent.
stage_b_next_rgb_and_gold.annotation_record: annotation_queue_unfilled.json is a blank queue. validate_gold_record checks structure, not reviewer identity or annotation accuracy. Empty forms cannot count as target-free scenes.
before_any_rgb_extraction: Check original imagery terms and attribution chain using retained source links.
Write a bounded member-range extraction protocol that checks local headers, exact compressed sizes, CRC and SHA256, with no automatic full-archive fallback.
stage_b_next_rgb_and_gold.effort: Time the first hash-ranked pair per event for each reviewer; project effort from those three timings while keeping all 18 fixed. No duration or labor availability is claimed now.
stage_b_next_rgb_and_gold.human_gold: Review whole selected scenes, trace or verify individual building polygons and stable scene-local IDs; grade visible damage using no/minor/major/destroyed/unknown. Unknown is not negative. Labels describe visible imagery, not field-verified structural safety.
stage_b_next_rgb_and_gold.instance_rule: No automatic conversion of connected components into primary building instances. Original polygons require identity verification; otherwise human-traced identities and polygon provenance are explicit.
stage_b_next_rgb_and_gold.review_blinding: First review uses paired RGB only, without detector predictions or EBD masks. A distinct second reviewer adjudicates every selected scene and records disagreement. Human expertise and effort are reported, never fabricated.

stage_c_future_measurement.before_inference: Freeze gold and model/cache lineage; finalize a 4x4 grid implementation with structural checks before any scores.
stage_c_future_measurement.coarse_rule: BOX downsample by8, 16x16 coarse pixels per128x128 native cell, matching the old per-cell public cue scale. Old 1024px scenes used128px coarse RGB; new512px scenes use64px. New size-aware adapter required; old 8x8 runner is not executed unchanged.
stage_c_future_measurement.detector: Same ChangeOS checkpoint, code and severe-declaration/degradation rules already frozen in v2. No fine-tuning.
stage_c_future_measurement.execution_device: Local CPU/MPS first; no paid GPU or controller training.
stage_c_future_measurement.matching: Preserve raster_visibility_v2: at least4 pixels and primary10% visible footprint overlap; report5/10/25% sensitivity and merged/split association cases. This remains an engineering proxy, not standard instance AP.
measurement_outputs: per-event reviewed and unknown building counts
per-event distinct severe targets and native/blurred opportunity counts
prediction component to human-instance association QA including merged/split buildings
target-free scene count, false positives and unscorable scenes
event-wise fixed source bin predicted vs observed discovery and conditional upgrade statistics
stage_c_future_measurement.stopping: If gold cannot distinguish instances or association proxy is invalid, stop before policy scoring and revise measurement prospectively. If any event has no detectable severe target, retain it and report that a three-event positive-search claim is unsupported; no target-enrichment sampling.

stage_d_future_descriptive_policy_replay.adaptation_boundary: No target-label calibration or method tuning on these scores. Any later trusted online label/oracle action needs explicit cost and a new protocol; paid detector feedback is not ground truth.
baselines: serial two stage MF-ENS-inspired cost adaptation
stage_d_future_descriptive_policy_replay.comparison: Compare policies only within the new512px/4x4/budget8 protocol. Absolute counts cannot be compared with old1024px/8x8/budget32 as improvement.
stage_d_future_descriptive_policy_replay.online_boundary: Only free coarse RGB features, frozen source aggregate statistics and paid local boolean feedback enter policy. Human IDs, labels, target counts, future quality and evaluation associations stay evaluator-only.
stage_d_future_descriptive_policy_replay.primary_reporting: Average seeds within scene, scenes within event, then three events equally. Show every event and all zero-target scenes; target-free recall is null. Only three events: descriptive feasibility, not a powered efficacy result.
stage_d_future_descriptive_policy_replay.randomness: Reuse quality seeds20261025..20261029 and random tie seeds20261030..20261039. Row/raw-change ties remain sensitivity checks; do not pick best tie on target scores.
stage_d_future_descriptive_policy_replay.requires: Gold, provenance and measurement gates recorded in a separate execution receipt. No replay authorized by metadata success alone.
stage_d_future_descriptive_policy_replay.secondary: Budgets4/16, costs1/4 and native/blurred sensitivity only under the same fixed cohort and no parameter selection.
stage_d_future_descriptive_policy_replay.source_model: Use development_fit aggregate model in output/disaster_search_development72_budget_controls_v1/models.json unchanged. Do not select among held-event fits on target performance.
